title: NLP-gestützte Erschließung von Metadaten in epigraphischen Datenbanken: Vokabular, Goldstandard und Methodenvergleich geprüft am Datensatz der Epigraphischen Datenbank Heidelberg (EDH)
description: A multilingual iconographic vocabulary (374 depicted elements, category tree, German/Latin/English search terms, 354 motif rules), aligned with Iconclass and the EAGLE vocabulary "Decoration"; a hand-annotated gold standard of 1,100 randomly drawn comments of the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (EDH), with a concordance to Trismegistos and EDCS; and a comparison of four methods (dictionary matching, lemmatisation, dependency parsing, fine-tuned BERT) that extract iconographic motifs from the free-text comments, with the complete code to reproduce all reported scores. Part of a PhD project on figurative decoration on Late Antique funerary inscriptions.
notes: Produced within the HERMES research study 'NLP-gestützte Erschließung von Metadaten in epigraphischen Datenbanken' (2026, Leibniz Institute of European History, IEG), funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research and the European Union (NextGenerationEU): https://www.hermes-hub.de/forschen/forschungsstudien/2026/IEG/nlp-gest%C3%BCtzte-erschlie%C3%9Fung-von-metadaten-in-epigraphischen-datenbanken.html.
